bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to clean water; appropriating money for a grant for shoreline restoration along Lake Minnetonka.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAKE MINNETONKA SHORELINE RESTORATION.

$102,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Soil and Water Resources for a grant to the city of Wayzata to improve water quality in Lake Minnetonka by restoring shoreline, adding native vegetation and pollinator habitat, and upgrading stormwater detention basins along the lake.
additions: $102,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the clean water fund to the Board of Soil and Water Resources for a grant to the city of Wayzata to improve water quality in Lake Minnetonka by restoring shoreline, adding native vegetation and pollinator habitat, and upgrading stormwater detention basins along the lake.
